entities.name: Extended rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Information element that informs the UE about S-NSSAIs that were included in the requested NSSAI but were rejected by the network.

entities.name: UE support for Extended rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Condition indicating that the UE supports the Extended rejected NSSAI information element.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information that was included in the requested NSSAI but rejected by the network.

entities.name: Requested NSSAI
entities.description: Network Slice Selection Assistance Information requested by the UE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Registration request message sent by the UE containing the requested NSSAI.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the requested NSSAI information element.
Requested NSSAI contains one or more S-NSSAIs.
Extended rejected NSSAI contains rejected S-NSSAIs from the requested NSSAI.
Inclusion of Extended rejected NSSAI is conditional on UE support for this IE.
